This role provides Tier 1 and Tier 2 support for hardware, software, mobile devices, Microsoft 365 applications, user access, and connectivity issues while helping maintain company technology assets and supporting onboarding, offboarding, and technology deployment activities. **End User Support & Help Desk**

* Serve as the first point of contact for employees requiring technical assistance.
* Respond to, troubleshoot, and resolve support requests received through the ticketing system, email, phone, or in person.
* Diagnose and resolve Windows, Microsoft 365, printer, hardware, software, mobile device, VPN, and connectivity issues.
* Provide technical guidance and user support to employees with varying levels of technical proficiency.
* Document support requests, troubleshooting efforts, and issue resolutions accurately and thoroughly.

**Technology Deployment & Device Management**

* Configure, deploy, replace, maintain, and troubleshoot laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, and related peripherals.
* Prepare and provision technology equipment for new employees and support onboarding and offboarding activities.

* Assist with Microsoft Intune enrollment, device management, and troubleshooting activities.

**Account Administration & Security Support**

* Perform approved password resets, account modifications, security group updates, and other routine user administration tasks.
* Support Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and related user-access activities.
* Assist with endpoint security initiatives, software updates, remediation efforts, and security compliance activities.
* Identify and promptly escalate suspected phishing attempts, malware events, cybersecurity concerns, or other security-related incidents.
* Follow established IT policies, procedures, and security protocols.

**Asset Management & Operational Support**

* Maintain accurate inventory records for computers, mobile devices, peripherals, and other technology assets.
* Receive, tag, track, recover, redeploy, and dispose of equipment in accordance with company procedures.
* Assist with hardware refresh projects, equipment deployments, inventory audits, and other IT initiatives.
* Perform basic wired and wireless network troubleshooting and escalate complex infrastructure issues when appropriate.
* Support continuous improvement efforts related to technology, user support, documentation, and IT operations.

* Execute other related duties as needed or assigned to support evolving business priorities.
* Participate in occasional after-hours activities related to equipment deployments, upgrades, or business-critical support needs.
* Maintain confidentiality when working with sensitive systems, employee information, and company data.

**Qualifications**

* High School Diploma or GED required. Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent combination of training and practical experience preferred.

* Experience troubleshooting Dell laptops, desktops, docking stations, printers (PrinterLogic), mobile devices, and common business software.

* Basic understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, VPN connectivity, and network troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting iPhones, iPads, and other mobile devices preferred.
* Experience with Dell business computers or similar enterprise hardware is preferred.
* Experience using help desk or ticket management systems preferred.
* CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft Fundamentals, or similar certifications preferred but not required.
* Experience with building access systems.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Customer service mindset with a positive and proactive approach to problem-solving and the ability to communicate technical information clearly and professionally.
* Self‑driven professional with a strong sense of ownership and a disciplined work ethic.
* Ability to work independently on routine issues while recognizing when escalation is appropriate.
* Strong attention to detail and organized.
* Able to manage multiple priorities, prioritize and work effectively, and meet deadlines.
* Commitment to continuous improvement.

At EMCOR Services Aircond, you’ll be part of a team that values integrity, safety, empowerment, teamwork, and continuous improvement. We offer careers where ***good work*** is **valued, respected, and rewarded** and you will have the ability to make a meaningful impact in a growing organization.

---------------------

We are seeking an experienced Systems Engineer to support and maintain enterprise endpoint management and mobile architecture systems. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Azure Administration, Active Directory, and Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager.

This position is responsible for maintaining, configuring, and ensuring the reliable operation of endpoint management systems, including laptops and mobile devices. The engineer will troubleshoot technical issues, manage escalated support incidents, develop application packages, and support Microsoft 365 environments.

The role also involves researching emerging technologies, recommending system improvements, developing technical documentation, and supporting the future direction of End User Support systems.

Work Arrangement: This is a hybrid position with a strong onsite requirement. The selected candidate should expect to work onsite more days than remotely. Some weeks may require five days onsite.

* Minimum 3 years of experience working with Windows 10/11, Windows Server 2012–2019, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft Teams.
* Minimum 3 years of experience supporting computer peripherals, network copiers, and video conferencing equipment.
* Hands-on experience with Active Directory and Azure administration.
* Strong troubleshooting, diagnostic, and problem-solving abilities.
* Experience administering laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.

**Preferred Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* PowerShell scripting and automation.
* Microsoft Azure administration and Azure Admin Portal.
* Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Teams Administration.
* ServiceNow ticketing system experience (San Diego or later version).
* Windows 11 operating system experience.
* Windows Server administration.
* Security and patch management.
* Basic network troubleshooting, diagnostics, and repair.
* Knowledge of Ethernet, Wi-Fi, network topology, and network routing.
* Experience with Android and iPhone device administration and support.
* Experience with Microsoft Office 365 mainstream products, including Microsoft Teams, Teams Premium, and New Outlook.
* Experience with hardware and software infrastructure tools.
* Application and software installation and troubleshooting.
* Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation and knowledge articles.
* Inventory management principles.
* Experience supporting printers, copiers, peripherals, and video conferencing equipment.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build, configure, and deliver application packages for Microsoft Intune Endpoint Manager.
* Maintain, configure, and ensure reliable operation of endpoint management and mobile architecture systems.
* Administer and manage mobile devices, laptops, desktops, and other endpoint devices.
* Provide administration and support for Microsoft Azure, Azure Admin Portal, Microsoft Entra ID, and Active Directory.
* Manage and coordinate urgent and complex technical support issues.
* Serve as an escalation point for endpoint device-related incidents and service requests.
* Develop support methodologies and escalation procedures to ensure proper issue resolution and information flow.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating systems, network connectivity, and endpoint-related issues.
* Support Microsoft 365 applications, including Microsoft Teams, Teams Premium, and New Outlook.
* Train, coach, and mentor technical support staff.
* Develop, edit, publish, and maintain training materials and technical documentation, including video-based instructions.
* Interact with internal and external customers to understand and resolve technical issues.
* Prepare and provide weekly, monthly, and ad hoc KPI reports and trend analysis.
* Maintain and improve IT support frameworks, processes, and service delivery.
* Advise management on escalated incidents, recurring technical issues, and identified trends.
* Recommend technical solutions, system enhancements, and additional support requirements.
* Research emerging technologies and recommend improvements to endpoint and end-user support systems.
* Maintain documentation and knowledge articles to support consistent IT operations.

**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Systems Engineer with strong experience in Microsoft endpoint management technologies and enterprise IT support environments.

A successful candidate will:

* Have strong practical experience with Microsoft Intune, Azure AD / Entra ID, Active Directory, and Endpoint Configuration Manager.
* Be comfortable managing and troubleshooting Windows-based endpoints and mobile devices.
* Have experience supporting Microsoft 365 applications and enterprise IT infrastructure.
* Be capable of handling complex technical incidents and acting as an escalation point.
* Possess strong analytical, communication, documentation, and customer service skills.
* Be comfortable training and mentoring technical support staff.

title: Information Technology (IT) Sales Representative
description:
A leading provider of innovative, high-quality Information Technology (IT) training and certification solutions is seeking an experienced, results-driven IT Training Sales Representative to join our growing team.

This is a full-time inside sales position focused on developing new business, managing client relationships, and driving revenue growth primarily through phone, email, virtual meetings, and other direct sales activities, with customer site visits as needed.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of selling IT training solutions, particularly to U.S. military branches and federal, state, and local government agencies. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a motivated sales professional to leverage established industry relationships, expand business opportunities, and earn a competitive six-figure income.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business Development:** Identify, pursue, and secure new business opportunities within the IT training industry, with a strong focus on military and government clients.
* **Client Relationship Management:** Develop and manage a portfolio of new and existing clients, building long-term relationships that drive repeat business and revenue growth.
* **Lead Generation and Prospecting:** Proactively engage prospective clients through phone calls, emails, virtual meetings, and other inside sales activities to identify training needs and present customized solutions.
* **Sales Presentations and Closing:** Effectively communicate the value of our IT training and certification solutions, prepare competitive proposals, negotiate terms, and close sales.
* **Military and Government Sales:** Leverage existing knowledge and relationships within military installations, government agencies, and procurement organisations to identify and secure training opportunities.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with internal teams, including Marketing, Training, and Testing, to ensure seamless service delivery and exceptional client satisfaction.
* **Sales Activity Management:** Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of client communications, sales opportunities, proposals, and account activities.
* **Market Awareness:** Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, certification programs, competitor offerings, and government training requirements.

**Required Qualifications — MUST HAVE**

Candidates must meet the following requirements:

* Proven sales experience in the IT training and certification industry.
* Demonstrated experience selling IT training solutions to U.S. military branches and government organizations.
* Experience managing the full sales cycle in an inside sales environment, from prospecting and lead generation through closing and account management.
* Established knowledge of military and government procurement processes, purchasing procedures, and training requirements.
* Proven ability to develop new business, manage client relationships, and consistently meet or exceed sales targets.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Self-motivated, organized, and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple sales opportunities independently.

**Performance Expectations**

Success in this position will be measured by the ability to:

* Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Generate new business opportunities and expand the company's military, government, and commercial client base.
* Build and maintain long-term client relationships that drive repeat business and customer retention.
* Deliver exceptional customer service and maintain a high level of client satisfaction.
* Collaborate effectively with internal teams and maintain accurate sales records to support business operations.

**Benefits**

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including:

* Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
* Generous paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays.
* Retirement plan with company matching contributions.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.

**Compensation**

* **Base Salary:** $85,000 annually.
* **Commission:** Performance-based commission in addition to base salary.
* **Earning Potential:** Six-figure annual compensation for successful sales performance.

**Join Our Team**

If you are an experienced IT training sales professional with a strong background in military and government sales, we encourage you to apply.

We are looking for a motivated individual who can leverage industry expertise, build lasting client relationships, and contribute directly to our continued growth and success.

Pay: $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Retirement plan

Work Location: In person
